label: BUG
title: Two people editing the same blueprint: the second save silently replaces the first person's change
date: TAVI 13 Nov 2026 (21:00 Cairo) · Zoho not checked live

panels.caption: Tab 1 renames the blueprint to "QA BP D2 tabs RENAMED IN TAB 1" and presses Save and Publish (published)
Tab 2 (opened before tab 1 saved) changes only the description and publishes: no warning. Result, also after reload: Version 2, name back to "QA BP D2 tabs"; tab 1's rename is lost

rows: Tab 2, opened earlier, changes the description and publishes
Tab 2 is told the blueprint changed since it was opened and can reload (no change lost)
Saved with no message; the rename from tab 1 is silently undone (same as NDC-2965 for Workflow Rules)
